sources.snippet: EpochDB — Agentic Memory Engine EpochDB is a high-performance, state-aware memory engine designed for lossless, tiered storage, atomic state management, and multi-hop relational reasoning. It is built specifically for AI agents that require perfect historical recall, long-term state persistence, and deterministic fact corrections.
